views.name: admin_order_activity
views.definition:
SELECT o.id,
    o.order_number,
    o.user_id,
    o.created_at,
    'order'::text AS activity_type,
    NULL::uuid AS redemption_id,
    NULL::uuid AS reward_id,
    NULL::text AS reward_name,
    NULL::integer AS points_spent,
    o.status,
    o.payment_status,
    o.total,
    o.pickup_code,
    o.notes
   FROM orders o
  WHERE is_admin()
UNION ALL
 SELECT r.id,
    r.redemption_code AS order_number,
    r.user_id,
    r.created_at,
    'redemption'::text AS activity_type,
    r.id AS redemption_id,
    r.reward_id,
    COALESCE(lr.title, 'Recompensa'::text) AS reward_name,
    r.points_spent,
    r.status,
    'confirmed'::text AS payment_status,
    (0)::numeric AS total,
    r.redemption_code AS pickup_code,
    NULL::text AS notes
   FROM (loyalty_redemptions r
     LEFT JOIN loyalty_rewards lr ON ((lr.id = r.reward_id)))
  WHERE is_admin();

views.name: admin_sales_analytics
views.definition:
SELECT (date_trunc('day'::text, created_at))::date AS sale_date,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((payment_status = 'confirmed'::text) AND (status <> 'rejected'::text))) AS confirmed_orders,
    COALESCE(sum(total) FILTER (WHERE ((payment_status = 'confirmed'::text) AND (status <> 'rejected'::text))), (0)::numeric) AS confirmed_revenue,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'rejected'::text)) AS rejected_orders,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'delivered'::text)) AS delivered_orders,
    COALESCE(avg(total) FILTER (WHERE ((payment_status = 'confirmed'::text) AND (status <> 'rejected'::text))), (0)::numeric) AS average_ticket
   FROM orders
  GROUP BY ((date_trunc('day'::text, created_at))::date);

views.name: admin_sales_daily
views.definition:
SELECT (date_trunc('day'::text, created_at))::date AS business_date,
    (count(*))::integer AS orders_count,
    COALESCE(sum(total), (0)::numeric) AS sales_total,
    COALESCE(avg(total), (0)::numeric) AS average_ticket
   FROM orders
  WHERE ((payment_status = 'confirmed'::text) AND (status <> 'cancelled'::text))
  GROUP BY ((date_trunc('day'::text, created_at))::date)
  ORDER BY ((date_trunc('day'::text, created_at))::date) DESC;

views.name: product_inventory_status
views.definition:
SELECT p.id,
    p.name,
    p.price,
    p.stock AS available_stock,
    (COALESCE(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN ((o.status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'preparing'::text, 'ready'::text])) AND (o.payment_status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'confirmed'::text]))) THEN oi.quantity
            ELSE 0
        END), (0)::bigint))::integer AS reserved_stock,
    ((p.stock + COALESCE(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN ((o.status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'preparing'::text, 'ready'::text])) AND (o.payment_status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'confirmed'::text]))) THEN oi.quantity
            ELSE 0
        END), (0)::bigint)))::integer AS total_stock,
    p.available
   FROM ((products p
     LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON ((oi.product_id = p.id)))
     LEFT JOIN orders o ON ((o.id = oi.order_id)))
  GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.price, p.stock, p.available;

views.name: product_review_summary
views.definition:
SELECT p.id AS product_id,
    COALESCE(round(avg(r.stars), 1), (0)::numeric) AS average_stars,
    (count(r.id))::integer AS review_count
   FROM (products p
     LEFT JOIN product_reviews r ON (((r.product_id = p.id) AND (r.status = 'approved'::text))))
  GROUP BY p.id;

views.name: product_sales_rankings
views.definition:
SELECT p.id AS product_id,
    p.name,
    COALESCE(sum(oi.quantity) FILTER (WHERE ((o.status = 'delivered'::text) AND (o.payment_status = 'confirmed'::text))), (0)::bigint) AS units_sold,
    (COALESCE(sum(((oi.quantity)::numeric * oi.price)) FILTER (WHERE ((o.status = 'delivered'::text) AND (o.payment_status = 'confirmed'::text))), (0)::numeric))::numeric(12,2) AS revenue,
    count(DISTINCT o.id) FILTER (WHERE ((o.status = 'delivered'::text) AND (o.payment_status = 'confirmed'::text))) AS order_count
   FROM ((products p
     LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON ((oi.product_id = p.id)))
     LEFT JOIN orders o ON ((o.id = oi.order_id)))
  GROUP BY p.id, p.name;

policies.using:

   FROM parent_food_blocks b
  WHERE ((b.student_user_id = effective_student_user_id()) AND (b.product_id = products.id))))) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ((product_nutrition n
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL regexp_split_to_table(COALESCE(n.ingredients, ''::text), '[,;\n\r]+'::text) ingredient(value))
     JOIN student_ingredient_blocks sb ON ((sb.student_user_id = effective_student_user_id())))
  WHERE ((n.product_id = products.id) AND (POSITION((((' '::text || sb.ingredient_key) || ' '::text)) IN (((' '::text || TRIM(BOTH FROM regexp_replace(lower(ingredient.value), '[^[:alnum:]]+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text))) || ' '::text))) > 0)))))))
